title: Assessments
lead: Browse assessment categories. Open an assessment to complete it. Content is available to admin accounts, or with an access code.

categories.title: Lunez Massage
categories.description: Knowledge and application assessments for Lunez Massage.

assessments.title: Lunez Massage Assessment 1
assessments.summary: 20 questions: 10 applied, 5 fill-in-the-gap, 5 article-reading checks. Choose an option, give your reason, then download a PDF and submit.
assessments.pdfPurpose: To assess whether a Zura Wellness Therapist understands the purpose, technique, timing, benefits, client expectation management, consent, hygiene, boundaries, safety and professional mindset required for Lunez Massage.

categories.title: Understanding Team Work
categories.description: Knowledge assessments for the Staff Teamwork Training Programme.

assessments.title: Day 1 Knowledge Assessment
assessments.summary: 5 questions on the meaning and importance of teamwork. Choose an option, give your reason, then download a PDF and submit.
assessments.articleLabel: Read Day 1: Meaning and Importance of Teamwork
assessments.pdfPurpose: To assess whether a Zura Spa staff member understands what teamwork is, how it differs from merely working in the same place, which behaviours build or damage trust, and how to offer appropriate help without abandoning their own duties.

assessments.title: Day 1 Lesson 3 Knowledge Assessment
assessments.summary: 5 questions on shared goals, individual duties and accountability. Choose an option, give your reason, then download a PDF and submit.
assessments.articleLabel: Read Day 1 Lesson 3: Shared Goals and Responsibilities
assessments.pdfPurpose: To assess whether a Zura Spa staff member understands shared goals versus individual responsibilities, who owns assigned duties, when to communicate blockers, and how to support colleagues without encouraging dependency.

assessments.title: Day 1 Lesson 4 Workplace Attitude Exercise
assessments.summary: 4 situations on how you would respond at work. Choose an option, give your reason, then download a PDF and submit.
assessments.articleLabel: Read Day 1 Lesson 4: How Individual Attitudes Affect Team Performance
assessments.pdfPurpose: To assess whether a Zura Spa staff member chooses professional responses to correction, a colleague's success, frustration, and a struggling teammate — without gossip, hostility, or neglect.

assessments.title: Day 1 Lesson 5 Ego or Team-First Exercise
assessments.summary: 5 situations on whether you choose ego or a team-first response. Choose an option, give your reason, then download a PDF and submit.
assessments.articleLabel: Read Day 1 Lesson 5: Putting Team Success Above Personal Ego
assessments.pdfPurpose: To assess whether a Zura Spa staff member can put team success above personal ego: consider ideas on merit, celebrate colleagues, own mistakes, share knowledge, and raise disagreement respectfully.
